title: Synth Templates
idiom: 1920s French pochoir stencil print, one cut plate printed three ways and a sheet still empty
hero_prompt: Hand-coloured pochoir stencil print in the manner of a 1920s French stencil portfolio, flat saturated colour laid through cut plates, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible stencil-brush stipple and paper texture, seen flat from directly above with no perspective, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no wood grain, wide panoramic composition: at the far left a thin brass stencil plate lies flat, with one long slot cut through it in the shape of a square-cornered line that goes up, across, down, across, up, across, down, like a square wave; to its right four sheets of cream paper lie side by side in a row; the first three are each printed through that same plate with the same square-cornered line, one in deep blue, one in vermilion, one in ochre, each with its own stipple; the fourth sheet at the far right is left completely bare, plain cream with nothing on it. Flat cream ground around them. Generous empty space.
